gloss: actor known for acting skill; character actor

definitions.explanation: An actor whose reputation rests on the quality of the performance rather than on looks or star appeal. Standard praise in Japanese entertainment coverage.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{演技派|えんぎは}だ。
examples.english: She is a genuinely skilled actor.

examples.japanese: この{役|やく}は{演技派|えんぎは}の{俳優|はいゆう}にしかできない。
examples.english: Only an actor of real skill can play this role.

examples.japanese: アイドルとしてデビューした{後|あと}、{地道|じみち}な{努力|どりょく}で{演技派|えんぎは}へと{転身|てんしん}した。
examples.english: After debuting as an idol, she made a steady effort and reinvented herself as a serious actor.

notes:
Formed from {演技|えんぎ} (acting) plus 〜{派|は} (type, school). Used as a noun ({演技派|えんぎは}だ) and attributively with の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演技派|えんぎは}{俳優|はいゆう}: an actor known for skill
- {演技派|えんぎは}{女優|じょゆう}: an actress known for skill
- {演技派|えんぎは}として{知|し}られる: to be known as a fine actor
- {演技派|えんぎは}に{転身|てんしん}する: to reinvent oneself as a serious actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実力派|じつりょくは}: genuinely talented performer — broader, covers singers and musicians too
- {個性派|こせいは}: a performer with a distinctive presence — praises uniqueness, not technique
